title: Settings
subtitle: Appearance, language, data import and export

appearance.title: Appearance and language
appearance.text: Choose the theme and the language of the interface. Your choices are saved.

text.one: Download your only transaction as a file that opens in Excel and Google Sheets.
text.other: Download all {{count}} transactions as a file that opens in Excel and Google Sheets.

import.title: Import CSV
import.help: Separator , or ; and dates as yyyy-mm-dd or dd/mm/yyyy. Headers in English or Portuguese. Missing categories are created.

errors.tooLarge: File too large. The limit is 2 MB.
errors.unreadable: The file could not be read.

data.title: Data
data.text: Your data lives in this browser only. Clearing removes every transaction and budget and keeps the default categories. Export a CSV first if you want a copy.

clearConfirm.title: Clear all data?
clearConfirm.message: All transactions, budgets and custom categories will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

restoreConfirm.title: Restore demo data?
restoreConfirm.message: Your current data will be replaced by the sample data.
